units: <cite ref="Mishnah Tamid 3:5">Tam. III, 5</cite> <he>של א׳</he> of cedar wood.—Pl. <cite ref="A03056"><he>אֲרָזִים</he></cite>.
R. Hash. 23ᵃ; Taan. 25ᵇ; a. e.—Metaph. prominent men, scholars.
<cite ref="Shabbat 118b:9">Sabb. 118ᵇ I</cite> planted <he>חמשה א׳</he> five cedars (begot five sons who acquired renown).
